import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long M;
    static long[][] newt;
    static long[][] inv_newt;

    static long spow(long a, long b) {
        long r = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                r = r * a % M;
            }
            a = a * a % M;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static long Inv(long a) {
        long b = M - 2;
        long r = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                r = r * a % M;
            }
            a = a * a % M;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static long f(int c, int p) {
        if (p == 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        return spow(c + 1, p - 1) * (c + 1 - p) % M;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        M = sc.nextLong();

        newt = new long[c + 3][c + 3];
        inv_newt = new long[c + 3][c + 3];

        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 2; i++) {
            newt[i][i] = 1;
            newt[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                newt[i][j] = (newt[i - 1][j] + newt[i - 1][j - 1]) % M;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= c + 2; j++) {
                inv_newt[i][j] = Inv(newt[i][j]);
            }
        }

        long ans = f(c, p);
        ans = ans * spow(2, p) % M;

        long sum_e = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
            long e = 0;
            for (int w = 1; w <= i - 1; w++) {
                long zioms = newt[i - 1][w] * f(w, w) % M * f(c - w - 1, i - 1 - w) % M;
                zioms = zioms * Inv(spow(c + 1, i - 1)) % M;
                e = (e + w * (w + 1) / 2 % M * zioms) % M;
            }
            sum_e = (sum_e + e) % M;
        }

        System.out.println((ans * sum_e) % M);
        sc.close();
    }
}
